question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling error in the following sentence.

In his persuit of excellence, he forgot to take care of his health.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"persuit"** is a common misspelling and does not have any meaning in English. (गलत वर्तनी)
 
• **"Pursuit"** means the action of following or chasing after something or someone. (अनुसरण)
 
 
• **Example: **His pursuit of knowledge led him to read hundreds of books.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
